request.style: English, female solo voice, solemn and clear, cello, piano, harp, organ, gentle choir, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the hill country of Seir he settled
Away from his brother Jacob
His possessions were too great to stay
The land could not support them
So Esau is Edom the father
Of the people in the mountains

[Chorus]
Chief Magdiel Chief Iram
These were the chiefs of Edom
According to their settlements
In the land they possessed

[Verse]
From the daughters of Canaan he took wives
Adah and Oholibamah
Basemath the sister of Nebaioth
Born in the land of Canaan
Eliphaz and Reuel were born
To his children in the hills

[Chorus]
Chief Magdiel Chief Iram
These were the chiefs of Edom
According to their settlements
In the land they possessed

[Verse]
Timna Alvah and Jetheth
Oholibamah Elah Pinon
Kenaz Teman Mibzar
Named in the family history
Before Israel had kings
Edom had its chiefs

[Chorus]
Chief Magdiel Chief Iram
These were the chiefs of Edom
According to their settlements
In the land they possessed

[Outro]
This was Esau
The father of the Edomites
